# rquickjs-sys 0.14.0, patched for Android

The crates.io release of rquickjs-sys 0.14.0, unchanged, plus four generated files in
`src/bindings/`: `aarch64-linux-android.rs`, `armv7-linux-androideabi.rs`,
`x86_64-linux-android.rs` and `i686-linux-android.rs`.

rquickjs ships no bindings for Android, so without these an Android build stops unless the
`bindgen` feature is on (which needs libclang and the NDK sysroot on every build machine).
They're generated by `native/tools/android-bindings/generate.sh` with the same bindgen settings
as this crate's `build.rs`, for each Android target. The same generator reproduces the shipped
x86_64, aarch64 and i686 Linux bindings exactly (whitespace aside), and every generated file
contains bindgen's size and alignment checks, which the compiler runs for the real target.

Don't copy another target's file instead: some shipped ones are stale (the
`armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi` file predates the current `JS_NewArrayBuffer`, which broke the
first armv7 build), and 32-bit x86 aligns 64-bit values differently from 32-bit ARM.

Used through `[patch.crates-io]` in `native/testtube-core/Cargo.toml`. When rquickjs is
upgraded, copy the new release here and run `generate.sh` again (or drop this folder if
upstream starts shipping Android bindings).
